title: AltimitMovement and Galv's Character Animations plugin is incompatible

posts.author: Deeppink_man
posts.body:
(Since I'm not an English speaker, I used a translator.)
I tried to make this in my game:
- eight-way movement
- Assign different animations to stand, walk, jump, and jump
- Pixel movement (like undertale)
- Smoother animation frames (increase in number of frames)
So I almost succeeded with the plugin that Galv made, and I was able to make what I wanted if only pixel movement was added, but AltimitMovement and Character Animals plugin don't seem to be compatible. And I don't know how to fix this.
AltimitMovement
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/altimit-pixel-movement-0-50v.85408/
Galv's Character Animations plugin
https://galvs-scripts.com/2020/09/01/mz-character-animations/

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
If you are using MZ I'd suggest you use TyrusWoo's MZ port of Altimit. I know it fixes some bugs for MZ
Tyruswoo Altimit Movement MZ | Tyruswoo Studio
Plugin for RPG Maker MZ. Add pixel movement to your game! Includes a command to recalculate tile boundaries, for compatibility with Tile Control MZ!
www.tyruswoo.com
